title: Pacer Rules — Western States Endurance Run
claims: A runner may have one pacer at a time, starting from the Foresthill aid station (mile 62) to the finish in Auburn; since 2025 pacers and crew are not allowed anywhere along Bath Rd, and must wait inside the official Foresthill aid station, except pacers starting at Michigan Bluff.
A runner leaving Michigan Bluff (mile 56) after 8:00 p.m. may have a pacer from that point.
Pacer changes are allowed only at Foresthill aid station, Rucky Chucky river crossing near (north) side, Green Gate aid station, Pointed Rocks aid station and Robie Point.

Each pacer picks up a pacer number and signs a release form at Pacer Central, either at Olympic Valley on Friday morning or at Foresthill Elementary School after noon on Saturday; three pacer numbers matching the entrant are provided per entrant.
Pacers must be at least 18 years old; exceptions may be requested in advance from the Race Director.

Pacers may assist with filling bottles or replenishing supplies at aid stations but must not enter ahead of their runner or depart after the runner to speed refueling; pacers may accept aid at aid stations.

Pacers may not carry water, food, flashlights, shoes, clothing or other supplies for their runner, and may not give mechanical or physical assistance on the course; muling is expressly forbidden, though pacers may carry their own supplies and food.

If a runner withdraws and their pacer wishes to continue, the pacer must stay at the aid station until another runner requests their services; a pacer may not continue on the trail without an official entrant.

More than one person (crew, pacer, friends, family) may accompany a runner without aid or muling from the top of Bath Road to the intersection of Main Street and California Street, and from Robie Point to the finish line.

claimVerification.note: Rule 1: one pacer at a time from Foresthill mile 62; 2025 Bath Rd restriction; wait inside official Foresthill aid station; Michigan Bluff exception.
Rule 2: Michigan Bluff mile 56 after 8 p.m. pacer start.
Rule 3: change points Foresthill, Rucky Chucky north side, Green Gate, Pointed Rocks, Robie Point.
Rule 4: pacer number and release form at Pacer Central; three numbers per entrant.
Rule 5: pacers at least 18; RD exceptions in advance.
Rule 6–7: enter/leave aid station with runner, identify to staff; bottle filling allowed, no ahead-of-runner entry.
Rule 8: no carrying runner's supplies or mechanical/physical assistance; muling forbidden; own supplies allowed.
Rule 9: withdrawn runner's pacer waits at aid station for another entrant.
Rule 10: companionship without aid on Bath Road top to Main/California St, and Robie Point to finish.
